A '''fine particle blower''' was a piece of scientific equipment. [[Scientist/Legends|Science]] team [[MS-133]] used a fine particle blower during the [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] dig on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aaris III]] along with other equipment including a [[Hand scanner/Legends|hand scanner]] and an [[electronic scale]].
